scene_text.text: Waist-up candid photograph of him standing squarely to the camera in a shopping-mall viewing gallery, shoulders level, his weight even on both feet. His face is turned about 20 degrees toward picture-right with his chin level and his eyes looking into the lens, a relaxed closed-lip smile and calm, confident eyes. A white non-woven tote bag hangs from his right shoulder at picture-left, its flat strap crossing the top of his tee, while his other arm hangs relaxed at his side with a round black smartwatch on that wrist. He wears an oversized, boxy cream cotton crew-neck t-shirt with short sleeves; across the chest is the print shown in the PRINT DESIGN image, copied exactly: four centred lines of wide, round geometric sans-serif capital letters in a bright crimson red, reading I DON'T CARE / IF SHE GOT / RED FLAGS in bold, and I'M A BULL below them in a regular, thinner weight, filled solid red like the rest and not outlined. Behind him is a large floor-to-ceiling glass wall with a dark metal frame at the picture-right edge, and beyond it a multi-level mall atrium with warm and white shop lights, softly blurred. Soft, even indoor light from the front, low contrast, neutral-warm tones. Camera at his chest height about 1.5 metres away, phone 1x lens, he is sharp and the atrium is softly blurred. Natural colour, realistic phone photograph with natural skin texture and slight grain. Vertical 2:3 frame.
